note: The measurement table of the alate is printed in two columns in the original scan, so only the legible ranges are used here; the soldier measurements are of the holotype and 8 paratypes. The specific name refers to the small eyes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
The alate differs from those of Glyptotermes tuberifer and G. adamsoni in the smaller eyes and the longer and broader wings. The soldier head is elongate and broader posteriorly, the sides slightly converging anteriorly and slightly concave in the middle; the median notch of the frons is broad and deep, the anterodorsal projection angular and high, and the frontal face concave in lateral view; the mandibles are stout with the outer margin slightly concave in the middle.

The type locality is the Northern Range of Trinidad (about 10°45′ N, 61°30′ W), at an altitude of 1800 feet, collected by A. M. Adamson on 28 October 1938 (month 10), number 3117; paratypes were also collected at Arima, Trinidad (altitude 2800 feet) and at Morne Bleu (altitude 1800 feet).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head brownish yellow with smoky patches; pronotum brownish yellow, paler than the head, with a dark T-shaped mark in the middle (in paratype-nest specimens the head and pronotum are reddish brown); antennae and legs pale yellow; nota reddish brown; wings smoky, the wing scales darker. Head with a few sparse long setae. Y-suture distinct. Eyes small, shaped as figured. Ocelli small, touching the eyes. Antennae 12—13-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 longer than segment 4. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin deeply concave, sides rounded, posterior margin slightly concave. The media of the hindwing arises from the radial sector beyond the wing scale, about 1.15 mm from the wing suture.

Measurements of 6 alates: head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.08—1.13 mm; head length (to the base of the mandibles) 0.90—0.94 mm; head width 0.91—0.98 mm; eye diameter 0.24 mm; distance from the lower margin of the eye 0.11—0.14 mm; ocellus length 0.11 mm; pronotum median length 0.49—0.53 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.58—0.66 mm; pronotum width 0.77—0.83 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.77 mm; forewing length from the suture 6.00—6.93 mm; forewing width 1.65—1.80 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head dark brown, the frontal region dark reddish brown, nearly black near and above the antennal sockets; mandibles blackish brown; pronotum and labrum brownish yellow, paler than the head; antennae and legs brown. Head with a few sparse erect setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with setae; nota with about 7—8 setae in a single row. Head elongate, broader posteriorly, the sides slightly converging anteriorly and slightly concave in the middle; median notch of the frons broad and deep; anterodorsal projection angular and high; frontal face concave in lateral view. Y-suture indistinct. Eyes small. Mandibles stout, the outer margin slightly concave in the middle; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first narrow at the base, the second and third broad at the base; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth lying 0.29 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Postmentum shaped as figured, not strongly constricted in the middle. Antennae 10—11-segmented; in the 10-segmented condition segment 3 is longer than segment 4, in the 11-segmented one the reverse. Pronotum almost as wide as the head, anterior margin angular, anterolateral corners narrow, sides rounded, posterolateral margins rounded, posterior margin slightly concave. Femora moderately inflated.

Soldier measurements (holotype; range / mean of 8): head length (to the base of the mandibles) 1.50 mm / 1.35—1.50 mm / 1.44 mm; head width 0.99 mm / 0.94—1.05 mm / 0.99 mm; head height 0.90 mm / 0.90—0.92 mm / 0.90 mm; length of the left mandible 0.72 mm / 0.68—0.73 mm / 0.70 mm; postmentum maximum width 0.38 mm / 0.34—0.38 mm / 0.37 mm; postmentum minimum width 0.23 mm / 0.23—0.24 mm / 0.23 mm; postmentum length 0.94 mm / 0.83—0.94 mm / 0.90 mm; pronotum median length 0.49 mm / 0.45—0.49 mm / 0.46 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.60 mm / 0.53—0.62 mm / 0.58 mm; pronotum width 0.90 mm / 0.79—0.92 mm / 0.89 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.60 mm / 0.60 mm / 0.60 mm.
